source.integration: Conflict-free exact fast-forward from the authorized baseline; no B1 change was included.

causeAndRepair.demonstratedCause: The generic 480px dialog left a narrow detail column beside the revision rail, while old wrapping hooks did not match the rendered [data-history-detail] pre or explicit-message buttons. Synthetic long content overflowed horizontally in all 20 baseline browser cases.
causeAndRepair.repair: A History-only dialog width is clamped inside the CSS viewport, and actual detail, pre, metadata, and message-button elements can shrink and wrap anywhere. Narrow revision choices remain usable through horizontal navigation.
causeAndRepair.preserved: All stored content, descriptions and messages; revision selection; pagination; vertical scrolling; sticky close; Escape and focus behavior; generic work-item editors; and the separate Feature History & Report.
causeAndRepair.limit: Playwright WebKit is not native Safari. The device-scale case is a repeatable 200%-zoom-equivalent CSS viewport simulation, not native browser zoom or owner-device testing.
